WITH bounded_months AS (SELECT "CompanyId", "PeriodEnd" FROM (SELECT monthly_periods.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "CompanyId" ORDER BY "PeriodEnd" DESC) AS "PeriodRank" FROM (SELECT (SELECT mc."Id" FROM "public"."Companies" mc WHERE mc."ExternalCompanyId" = r0."ExternalCompanyId" AND mc."ProviderName" = r0."ProviderName") AS "CompanyId", r0."PeriodEnd" AS "PeriodEnd" FROM "public"."MonthlyReports" r0 WHERE (r0."ProviderName", r0."ExternalCompanyId") IN (SELECT mc."ProviderName", mc."ExternalCompanyId" FROM "public"."Companies" mc WHERE mc."Id" = @company_id) AND r0."ProviderName" = @provider_name AND r0."ReportType" = @report_type AND r0."OutputType" = @output_type AND r0."IsAccepted" = @is_accepted AND r0."RevisionStatus" = @revision_status AND r0."PeriodStart" >= @period_start AND r0."PeriodEnd" <= @period_end AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."MonthlyReportLineItems" li0 WHERE li0."MonthlyReportId" = r0."Id" AND li0."ProductCode" = @product_code) GROUP BY (SELECT mc."Id" FROM "public"."Companies" mc WHERE mc."ExternalCompanyId" = r0."ExternalCompanyId" AND mc."ProviderName" = r0."ProviderName"), r0."PeriodEnd") monthly_periods) ranked_months WHERE "PeriodRank" <= @maximum_periods),
eligible_monthly_rows AS (SELECT (SELECT mc."Id" FROM "public"."Companies" mc WHERE mc."ExternalCompanyId" = r."ExternalCompanyId" AND mc."ProviderName" = r."ProviderName") AS "CompanyId", r."PeriodStart" AS "PeriodStart", r."PeriodEnd" AS "PeriodEnd", li."ProductCode" AS "ProductCode", li."Title" AS "ProductTitle", li."ProductionQuantity" AS "Value", li."Unit" AS "SourceUnit", COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY (SELECT mc."Id" FROM "public"."Companies" mc WHERE mc."ExternalCompanyId" = r."ExternalCompanyId" AND mc."ProviderName" = r."ProviderName"), r."PeriodEnd", li."ProductCode") AS "SamePeriodCandidateCount", r."ProviderName" AS "ProviderName", r."ReportType" AS "ReportType", r."OutputType" AS "OutputType", r."RevisionStatus" AS "RevisionStatus", r."Id" AS "ReportIdentity", r."ExternalReportId" AS "ExternalReportId", li."SourceRowFingerprint" AS "SourceRowFingerprint", li."SourceMultiplicity" AS "SourceMultiplicity" FROM "public"."MonthlyReportLineItems" li JOIN "public"."MonthlyReports" r ON li."MonthlyReportId" = r."Id" WHERE (r."ProviderName", r."ExternalCompanyId") IN (SELECT mc."ProviderName", mc."ExternalCompanyId" FROM "public"."Companies" mc WHERE mc."Id" = @company_id) AND r."ProviderName" = @provider_name AND r."ReportType" = @report_type AND r."OutputType" = @output_type AND r."IsAccepted" = @is_accepted AND r."RevisionStatus" = @revision_status AND li."ProductCode" = @product_code AND r."PeriodStart" >= @period_start AND r."PeriodEnd" <= @period_end AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bounded_months bm WHERE bm."CompanyId" = (SELECT mc."Id" FROM "public"."Companies" mc WHERE mc."ExternalCompanyId" = r."ExternalCompanyId" AND mc."ProviderName" = r."ProviderName") AND bm."PeriodEnd" = r."PeriodEnd")),
projected_monthly_rows AS (SELECT * FROM eligible_monthly_rows)
